transcript: If I had sent the letter that day, everything might have been different My childhood friend had moved to a distant town All I had to do was write a single word of thanks A single letter would have been enough If I had had a little more courage at the time The letter would have reached her And she might have remembered me for longer But I did not put it into words I hid my words away Treasuring them too carefully When I realized it I no longer knew the address of her town If I had written that one letter I might have been corresponding with her to this day Long after when I heard the news of her marriage I tasted that small regret once more I learned that a life can turn on the courage it takes To send a single letter

segments.text: If I had sent the letter that day, everything might have been different
My childhood friend had moved to a distant town
All I had to do was write a single word of thanks
A single letter would have been enough
If I had had a little more courage at the time
The letter would have reached her
And she might have remembered me for longer
But I did not put it into words
I no longer knew the address of her town
If I had written that one letter
I might have been corresponding with her to this day
Long after when I heard the news of her marriage
I tasted that small regret once more
I learned that a life can turn on the courage it takes
